info.title: Cyient DLM MPPL Escalation Tracker API
info.description:
Backend of the Cyient DLM workflow applications. Every endpoint needs sign-in unless it says otherwise.

**Sign-in (Development):** put a login in the `X-Dev-User` header, for example `CYIENTDLM\ims`, using the authentication box on this page. With no header the default user is used. `X-Dev-Groups` adds AD groups.

**Responses** use one envelope: `success`, `data`, `message`, `errors` (each with `code`, `message` and,
for a field, `field`), `meta` (paging: `page`, `pageSize`, `totalCount`, `totalPages`), `traceId` (quote it
when reporting a problem), `timestamp` and `durationMs`. Files (downloads, Excel, PDF) are sent as they are.

**Errors:** 400/422 validation (`errors[].field` names the field), 401 not signed in, 403 not allowed or not
set up (`AUTH_NOT_REGISTERED`), 404 not found, 409 conflict, such as `PLATFORM_VERSION_CONFLICT` when someone
else saved first, 429 too many calls.

**Changes:** send back the `version` from the last read; a stale one gets 409. New drafts take an
`Idempotency-Key` header, so a repeated click returns the same draft. Dates are `yyyy-MM-dd` in India
time; times are UTC. Enums travel as names, such as `ImsReview`.

post.description:
Uploads a reference document, usually the supplier's email, to the buyer's draft as multipart/form-data (field "file"). The same file name again, or a "fileKey", adds a new version; earlier versions are kept.

**Permission:** `mppl.issue.create` (Raise an MPPL issue); by default the Supply Chain role.

**Limit:** 60 calls a minute per user; more get `429 PLATFORM_RATE_LIMITED`.

get.description:
The PO details of a PO line from the daily PO data: PO date, part number, quantity, supplier, MPN, make, system price, currency and MOQ. `404 MPPL_PO_LINE_NOT_FOUND` when the line isn't in the PO data.

**Permission:** `mppl.issue.create` (Raise an MPPL issue); by default the Supply Chain role.

The customer, customer group, segment, Sourcing Lead and escalation levels for a project and commodity, from the sourcing master. `404 MPPL_NO_SOURCING_LEAD` when the sourcing master has no row for them.

**Permission:** `mppl.issue.create` (Raise an MPPL issue); by default the Supply Chain role.

post.description:
Saves the New Issue form as a draft. Send a new Idempotency-Key per new draft; repeating it returns that draft.

Segment, customer and Sourcing Lead are filled in from the sourcing master for the project and commodity, and the PO details from the PO data for the PO and line; they are not sent. A PO line that isn't in the PO data gets `422 MPPL_PO_LINE_NOT_FOUND`; a project and commodity without a Sourcing Lead `422 MPPL_NO_SOURCING_LEAD`. Only Supply Chain raises issues.

**Permission:** `mppl.issue.create` (Raise an MPPL issue); by default the Supply Chain role.

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: A new GUID per new draft. Sending the same key again returns that draft instead of a second one.

post.description:
Closes an open issue, with an optional comment: it moves to Fixed Issues and the buyer is emailed. Closure is final; there is no reopen or send-back.

Only the Sourcing Lead named on the issue may close it; anyone else gets `403 AUTH_NOT_ASSIGNED_REVIEWER`. A closed issue gets `409 MPPL_NOT_OPEN`. Send the `version` from the last read.

**Permission:** `mppl.issue.view` (See Open Issues and Fixed Issues); by default the All Users, Supply Chain roles.

EmailDetails.description: An email with what caused it: who acted, and the workflow action (design 9.4).

EscalationItem.description: An escalation level the issue has reached, with who was emailed and when.

HistoryEntry.description: One line of an issue's history. Workflow lines have Stage, Action and Comment; data lines have Item (Issue, Escalation or Document), Action (Insert, Update, Download) and, for updates, Field with its old and new value.

userId.description: The user to give the role to: an `id` from the users list or the people picker.

adGroup.description: An Active Directory group as DOMAIN\Group; its members get the role.

HolderInput.description: Either a user or an AD group (DOMAIN\Group), not both.

documentCount.description: Reference documents (current versions); they are optional (BRD-07 section 5).

escalationLevel.description: The escalation level reached: 0 while the issue is only with the Sourcing Lead.

pendingWith.description: Who an open issue waits with. Pending since is `submittedAt`.

projectId.description: The `id` of a Project item (`GET /api/v1/masters/Project`). Required.

commodityId.description: The `id` of a Commodity item (`GET /api/v1/masters/Commodity`). Required.

poNumber.description: The PO number, as in the PO data. Required, at most 20 characters.

poLineNumber.description: The PO line number (10, 20, 30 ...), as in the PO data. Required.

issueTypeId.description: The `id` of an IssueType item (`GET /api/v1/masters/IssueType`). Required.

newPrice.description: The supplier's new price, for a price issue. Optional; zero or more.

newQuantity.description: The new quantity, for a price issue or a quantity correction. Optional; zero or more.

remarks.description: The buyer's comment. Optional, at most 4000 characters.

version.description: Required when editing: the version returned by the last read.

IssueInput.description: The New Issue form, as sent when creating or editing a draft (BRD-07 Screen 2, 3). Segment, customer group and Sourcing Lead come from the sourcing master, and the PO details from the daily PO data; they are not sent.

pendingWith.description: Who an open issue waits with: the Sourcing Lead or the escalation level it has reached. Pending since is `submittedAt`.

IssueListItem.description: One row of Open Issues or Fixed Issues: the columns of today's list (BRD-07 Screen 1), who the issue is pending with and since when, and the value impact.

timeZone.description: The zone DailyAt is in: the job's own, or the business time zone.

nextRun.description: When the Notification Service runs it next; null when the job is switched off.

LogEntry.description: One Log entry. Stage and Action are the codes; StageName and ActionName are how users know them (Sourcing Lead, Closed).

code.description: A short code, for example HYD. Required, at most 50 characters.

name.description: The name shown in drop-downs. Required, at most 200 characters.

isActive.description: False stops the item being offered; items are never deleted.

version.description: Needed when changing an item; ignored when creating one.

type.description: The list's key, used in the URLs: Location, Department or ReasonCategory.

name.description: The list's display name, for screens only.

pendingCount.description: Tasks waiting for the user in this application (the Pending Actions badge); null where the application has none.

NumberingCheckResult.description:
One counter compared with the numbers its application has actually given out. Numbers are gap-free by design
(design 5.7), so any missing or repeated number, or a counter below a used number, needs looking at.

PersonResult.description: One result of the people picker.

RoleHolder.description: One holder of a role: a user, or an AD group whose members hold it.

isActive.description: False switches the role off: its holders lose its permissions.

permissions.description: The full list of permission codes (`GET /api/v1/admin/permissions`); it replaces the current list.

version.description: Needed when changing a role; ignored when creating one.

RoleInput.description: A role's name, description, state and the full list of its permission codes.

projectId.description: The `id` of a Project item. Required.

commodityId.description: The `id` of a Commodity item, or empty for every commodity of the project without a row of its own.

customerGroup.description: Required, at most 200 characters; for example ABB for ABB US and ABB India.

segment.description: Segment or sector, for example Commercial. Required, at most 100 characters.

escalation1UserId.description: First escalation level, the Sourcing Lead's reporting manager.

escalation3UserId.description: Final escalation level, the supply chain head.

isActive.description: False stops the row being used for new issues. Rows are never deleted.

version.description: Required when changing: the version returned by the last read.

SourcingInput.description: A sourcing master row, as sent when adding or changing it. People are `id`s from the people picker.

StoredFile.description: One version of an uploaded document. Versions of the same document share a Guid StoredFile.FileKey.

UserRoleItem.description: A role the user holds directly; int UserRoleItem.HolderId is used to remove it.

isActive.description: False switches the user off, true switches them on again.

version.description: The `version` from the last read; a stale one gets `409 PLATFORM_VERSION_CONFLICT`.

commit.description: The git commit the build came from, so support can tell exactly which build is running.

comment.description: Optional. On close, the Sourcing Lead's comment, for example "price changed to 755" or "supplier keeps the price" (RULE-03); it is kept as the sourcing comment and shown on the Log.

version.description: The `version` from the last read; a stale one gets `409 PLATFORM_VERSION_CONFLICT`.

WorkflowActionInput.description: A workflow action: an optional comment and the version from the last read.

DevUser.description: Development sign-in: the login to act as, for example `CYIENTDLM\ims`. Left empty, calls are made as the default user.
DevUser.name: X-Dev-User

tags.name: Me
tags.description: The signed-in user, with the roles and permission codes the front end uses to show or hide actions.

tags.name: Master lists
tags.description: Master lists. Anyone signed in reads the active items (for drop-downs); administrators with master.manage see inactive ones too, add items and change them.

tags.name: People picker
tags.description: The people picker, for choosing approvers (design 6.7). Any signed-in user; only active people are found.

tags.name: System
tags.description: Which build of the application this server runs. Any signed-in user.

tags.name: Issues: New Issue form
tags.description: What the New Issue form fills in as the buyer types (BRD-07 Screen 2, 3). The drop-downs are the master lists: `GET /api/v1/masters/Project`, `Commodity` and `IssueType`.

tags.name: Issues: drafts
tags.description: MPPL issues: the New Issue form saved as a draft, and one issue with what the user may do with it (design 6.7).

tags.name: Issues: lists
tags.description: Open Issues, Fixed Issues and the Excel download (design 6.7). Files are the one response not wrapped in the envelope; an error before the file starts still is.

tags.name: Issues: reference documents
tags.description: The reference documents of an issue (design 6.7): upload a file or a new version, list them, download one.

tags.name: Issues: workflow
tags.description: The MPPL workflow (design 6.7): submit, close, the Sourcing Lead's pending issues and the Log. Closing needs only the view permission here; that only the named Sourcing Lead may close is checked by the workflow itself.

tags.name: Admin: MPPL
tags.description: MPPL administration (design 6.8): every issue with close (request.admin) and the issue's emails, audit and history, and the sourcing master (master.manage). Projects, commodities and issue types are the master lists `Project`, `Commodity` and `IssueType` under `/api/v1/admin/masters`.

tags.name: Admin: audit, emails and logs
tags.description: The audit trail (audit.view), the email log with retry and resend (email.manage), and the technical log (log.view). Lists are newest first and paged.

tags.name: Admin: jobs
tags.description: The daily jobs (job.run): when each runs next in the Notification Service, and "run now". A job run now runs in this API and the call returns when it has finished.

tags.name: Admin: numbering
tags.description: Request-number counters and the numbering check (sequence.manage). Read-only: counters are never set by hand.

tags.name: Admin: roles
tags.description: Roles and their permissions (role.manage), and who holds them (user.manage). Holders are users or AD groups. A change that would leave nobody able to manage roles and users is refused.

tags.name: Admin: users
tags.description: People synced from Active Directory: search them, see their roles, switch them off or on in this application.
